meta.source: Compiled from Wikipedia nationality-law pages (approximate; verify against official sources before reliance).
meta.disclaimer: Informational only; not legal or immigration advice.

countries.name: Andorra
countries.note: Long residency (20 yrs); dual citizenship generally not allowed.

countries.name: Australia
countries.note: 4 yrs lawful residence (1 yr PR); fee AUD $540.

countries.name: Austria
countries.note: Dual citizenship restricted; investment route available; fee ≈ €1,115.

countries.name: Canada
countries.note: Descent limited to first generation abroad; 3 yrs physical presence; fee CAD $630.

countries.name: China
countries.note: Descent limited; naturalisation very restricted; dual not allowed.

countries.name: Egypt
countries.note: Dual with approval; citizenship by investment.

countries.name: Germany
countries.note: 5 yrs (3 with exceptional integration); dual allowed since June 2024.

countries.name: Iran
countries.note: Descent via father; dual not recognised.

countries.name: Ireland
countries.note: Grandparent descent via Foreign Births Register; 5 yrs (3 if married to a citizen).

countries.name: Italy
countries.note: Descent via ancestry (jure sanguinis, no generational limit); 10 yrs residence.

countries.name: Jordan
countries.note: Descent via Jordanian father; citizenship by investment.

countries.name: Liberia
countries.note: Naturalisation historically restricted by ancestry requirement.

countries.name: Liechtenstein
countries.note: Very long residency; dual citizenship restricted.

countries.name: New Zealand
countries.note: 5 yrs presence; no citizenship test; fee NZD $470.

countries.name: Nigeria
countries.note: Dual only for Nigerian citizens by birth.

countries.name: Poland
countries.note: Descent to great-grandparents; 3 yrs for spouses/descent (Karta Polaka).

countries.name: Portugal
countries.note: Descent to grandparents (and Sephardic heritage); fee ≈ €250.

countries.name: Russia
countries.note: Dual citizenship tolerated but not recognised.

countries.name: San Marino
countries.note: Long residency (30 yrs, 15 for spouses); dual restricted.

countries.name: Singapore
countries.note: Global Investor Programme; 2 yrs as PR (longer in practice); dual not allowed.

countries.name: Slovakia
countries.note: Descent to third generation; dual restricted.

countries.name: Spain
countries.note: 10 yrs (1 if married to a citizen); dual only for Ibero-American and select countries.

countries.name: Taiwan
countries.note: Naturalised citizens generally must renounce prior nationality.

countries.name: Türkiye
countries.note: Citizenship by investment via real estate or deposit.

countries.name: United Arab Emirates
countries.note: Golden visa available; naturalisation restricted (30 yrs or nomination).

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.note: Descent limited to one generation abroad (exceptions); fee ≈ £1,500.

countries.name: United States
countries.note: 5 yrs (3 if married); EB-5 investor visa; fee $725 + $85 biometrics.

countries.name: Vatican City
countries.note: Citizenship tied to office/residence in Vatican City; no general naturalisation.
